purpose: Standalone full-calendar feature provider for E47 and later explicitly reviewed E39/E41 reruns; no core/default changes and no performance evaluation.
calendar: All consecutive sorted futures_daily day dates define D->T before any signal filtering. Missing night, mismatched contracts, unknown flags, invalid prices or nonpositive volume make signal_valid false, never delete calendar rows. Preserve original >=200 base-date window only as a separate legacy_window flag.
night: Use verified corrected_data_v2 flags. Positive-volume traded x=0 remains valid. Mask x, abs(x), night range/volume/path/nvz when invalid. Volume normalization uses prior valid positive-volume observations; no missing-signal zero imputation.
current_cohort: Full calendar x frozen current universe is the master. At08:11, cohort_0811 needs only valid same-day last actual trade through08:10 and positive finite exact-D Close. Current y, current Open/Close validity, H membership and future snapshot availability never select this cohort. E47 feature-ready eligibility is a separate flag.
labels: Attach current y only after feature computation. Historical y requires finite positive Open/Close, immediately previous valid stock date equal D and finite gap. No realized magnitude filter. Ground truth is never filled.
point_model: Compute M1/F2/r2 on strictly prior last250 valid x+y rows, min120. Current y is not required. Match every common corrected_data_v2 point-table key to tolerance1e-12; table keys are not the feature master.
sigma06: EWMA root mean square of y-x, lambda0.94, strictly prior last250 VALID residuals, min60; mreg uses KS200 independently with same rule. Preserve first/last/count provenance.
sigma08: EWMA root mean square of y-g, lambda0.94, strictly prior last250 VALID residuals, min20; independent actual-NXT+y history, including missing-x/H/F2 dates. Preserve first/last/count provenance.
nxt: Reuse frozen E46 combine_nxt_sources and clean_trade_snapshots. Exact-minute development source wins duplicates; actual trades require finite positive price AND finite positive volume.08:10-start bar is available08:11. Same-day carry only; range is max-min actual minute closes through08:10. Record source, origin minute, available_at, age, volume, carry and duplicate decision. Do not use later-price existence to choose rows.
features: Rebuild lsd,mreg,rng,dis,drift,idio,volume history jointly. VIX uses ET16:15 as-of and change on complete KR snapshot calendar. NQ06->08 uses completed hourly bars and records staleness. Calendar and exact-D investor features never use current target.
differences_beyond_three_nights: full-calendar and target-independent master instead of prediction-table rows
last250 valid residuals instead of last250 rows then dropping missing
sd08 independent of H/F2 history membership
positive-volume actual trade source, exact-minute deduplication and same-day carry
exact-D previous-close and investor linkage; invalid night path/volume masking
tests_required: current/future targets cannot change today's features or eligibility
no-trade x/y cannot enter sd06/mreg or point training
NXT+y history retained when H absent
all training last dates before T
E47 label-only policy retains valid Open_T when current Close_T is zero/missing, without changing default histories
limitations: Repeated historical exploration, not new holdout
Current universe membership and current price vintage remain
Bar/session end is an availability proxy, not observed receipt time
No trading return or performance claim
Feature changes must be decomposed from point-table-only changes in any later rerun
target_attachment_api: load_targets(root, label_policy="legacy_close_valid") returns T/code/y/target_observed only. E47 must explicitly request label_policy="open_exact_prior_close": finite positive Open_T and exact-D finite positive Close_D, no current Close gate. Default E48 point/sd histories and load_panel labels stay legacy_close_valid. No outcome magnitude filter in either policy.
availability_limit: 06:00 night final and minute/hourly bar ends are availability proxies; actual final publication and vendor receipt timestamps are not recorded. No live availability certification.
